name: Reply_2024.10.23.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Hi. Levent,
Thanks for your information.
1, PVC mask file looks a little blurry, and I notice that there is not a big change
1.1: change LED description to your model name
1.2: add your logo
I think that is all, please let me know if any
With the PS file you shared, we will later work out a sample photo for your confirmation.
2, OK, so just for those 5 units, for 2 units of industrial switch, still use our MAC address?
3, We will remove “made in China” from the label.
Power cable is EU standard in the packing box, or here do you mean put this information on the label?
4, please see attached CI and let me know if this is what is needed for clearance.
Besides this, I would like to finalize something more with you.
Please see below label photo, this is for last order and also based on our daily practices.
Actually would like to finalize the format with you(kinda related to the 3rd point above)
Title
We have “Commercial Switch” and “Industrial Switch” and do not show if it is PoE or Managed on the title(just in description)
Font
We do Times New Roman
Serial Number
It is based on the production date(not shipping date or something, this order will be 20241022001~...)
Do you need a change of above information?(Maybe some not even listed)
We expect you to have a FINAL format for future orders
User Manual
Do you need to use your version?
Warranty Card
We do not have it, but will issue a “certification of warranty”
Is this OK?
Do you need a change or something?
Logo
In the PVC design, it is the blue logo, the same as last order we put it in WEB GUI, right?
We will always use this photo as long as your logo is involved, OK?(unless you explicitly inform us not or of a new photo)
MAC address
We will use yours and please just provide it when you have an order for us, OK?
Sometimes it is OK to use ours if it is not mandatory, it is up to you.
What do you think?
Product photos
We will always send actual photos of your order before shipment.
Like WEB GUI or packing photos...
BUT, please know that if a model is placed before, we will not send new photos when purchased again, just save the trouble.
This is OK?
Clearance
At our side, we can almost do nothing about your local import, just change the commercial invoice BEFORE shipment(just like this time, 4th point aforementioned)
So we will just help revise it as long as it helps clearance.
This is OK?
Currently this is almost all, maybe more in the future.
I will draft a separate file to include your reply and finalized rules, then upload it to the google drive folder.
This is just one point, establish formats/rules to make the discussion/business simple and standard.
Please let me know.
Thank you.
[页眉页脚]
s.sagatelecom@gmail.com
Saga Telecom
www.sagatelecom.com.cn
Connecting, Converting, Creating
